evals.prompt: Break the de-risked intent into the next level down.
evals.expected_output: A decomposition of exactly one level — child intents when the intent is above feature level (each a lower Level: with a Parent intent: back-link), or a shippable delivery unit at the leaf. The leaf is cut by shippability, never by component or layer. The decomposition decision is recorded. One independently shippable feature becomes a delivery contract; a multi-spec or cross-repository outcome becomes a coordinating delivery brief. It only decomposes an intent whose riskiest assumption has survived de-risking.
assertions: Decomposes exactly one level — child intents above feature, or a spec/slice at the leaf; does not skip levels
Cuts the leaf by shippability (a vertical unit that ships and tests on its own), never by component or layer
Records the decomposition decision — why the cut went this way, and any branch dropped
Projects by semantic role — one independently shippable feature → delivery contract; multi-spec or cross-repository outcome → delivery brief
Only decomposes a de-risked intent (riskiest assumption survived)
Each child carries a Parent intent: back-link

evals.prompt: Project the confirmed leaf to delivery. Compare a Wave-2-compatible Core invocation with Core absent, unknown, and pre-handoff-schema fixtures.
evals.expected_output: The compatible invocation receives a closed normalized-intake.v1 handoff through work-intake. Every other fixture submits through work-intake the same bounded role and content as a portable rendered handoff, without the unsupported top-level object. External locators remain opaque and no downstream approval is inferred.
assertions: Sends the machine object only when normalized-intake.v1#handoff is explicit
Renders a portable fallback for absent, unknown, and older Core, and submits it through work-intake
Treats external locators as opaque data
Does not skip new-spec or author-delivery-brief continue gates

evals.prompt: Decompose this capability-level intent into children. It needs a structural decomposition first. The architect skills are not in the available-skills roster.
evals.expected_output: Cuts the children by shippability and proceeds with no offer and no note about a design skill.
assertions: Cuts children by shippability, not by component
Does not mention architect, its skills, or their absence
Records the decomposition decision on the parent
